title: How Does AI Learn From Examples?
style: calm luminous storybook watercolor with clear cutaway mechanisms

pages.text: AI learns patterns from training data. The data can include pictures, words, sounds, or other examples.
A pattern is a clue that appears in many examples. AI can use these clues to make a guess.

quickWords.th: ลักษณะร่วม

pages.text: Show the AI pictures of dogs and other animals, with their names. It can learn clues that help it tell them apart.
AI can use learned patterns to predict a label or generate a new picture, song, or story. The output can be useful and still be wrong.
AI does not think like a person. It compares patterns very fast.

quickWords.th: เปรียบเทียบ

pages.text: AI guesses are not always right. It can call a cat a dog.
AI can make mistakes. People should check important answers instead of trusting every guess.

quickWords.th: ข้อผิดพลาด

pages.text: What can you use to check this answer? Try a trusted source, a real example, or a grown-up who can help.

quickWords.th: แหล่งข้อมูล

pages.text: AI uses learned patterns to make outputs. Can you explain why an AI output can be wrong?

quickWords.th: ลักษณะร่วมที่เรียนรู้
